scripts.deploy:quick: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name rj-master-sop-2026
scripts.migrate:local: for f in migrations/*.sql; do npx wrangler d1 execute rj-sop-operations --local --file "$f"; done
scripts.migrate:remote: for f in migrations/*.sql; do npx wrangler d1 execute rj-sop-operations --remote --file "$f"; done
scripts.seed:local: npx wrangler d1 execute rj-sop-operations --local --file seed.sql
